description: This file defines an abstract test runner class for streaming batch tests in an Orleans-based project. It includes test methods for single send/consume, batch send/consume, and combined batch send with batch consume, along with a utility method for checking consumption reports.

classes.name: StreamBatchingTestRunner
classes.description: An abstract class providing test methods for different stream batching scenarios in Orleans tests.

methods.name: SingleSendBatchConsume
methods.description: Tests sending individual messages to a stream and consuming them to verify the total count and batch size.

methods.name: BatchSendSingleConsume
methods.description: Tests sending batches of messages and consuming them as a single batch to verify total count.

methods.name: BatchSendBatchConsume
methods.description: Tests sending batched messages and consuming them in batches, verifying total count and batch size.

methods.name: CheckCounters
methods.description: Utility method to check if the consumer's consumption report matches expected values.
